WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT b.link_to_event, e.type, AVG(1.0 * b.spent / NULLIF(b.amount, 0)) AS avg_ratio
  FROM budget AS b
  JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
  GROUP BY b.link_to_event, e.type
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT type, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_event_ratio
  FROM step1
  GROUP BY type
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_event_ratio) AS overall_avg
  FROM step2
)
SELECT step2.type, step2.avg_event_ratio, step2.avg_event_ratio / step3.overall_avg
FROM step2 CROSS JOIN step3
WHERE step3.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
